_approach: An ultra-minimal, click-led 2-step in the vein of Jamie xx's sparse, off-kilter garage revivalism: a lone rim 'click' replaces the snare entirely, a ghost clave ticks underneath, and everything sits in wide, deliberate space rather than filling the bar. Ref: MasterClass 'Future Garage Guide' (off-kilter rhythmic style inherited from 2-step garage); Wikipedia '2-step garage' (history). (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
